Grafana for the platform: the apps' traces, metrics and logs, which they send over OpenTelemetry on the platform's network (the platform gives each app OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT), and the server's own CPU, memory, disk and network. Kept for retention_days. Grafana asks for its admin user's password (task secrets:init generates it); with grafana_domain, Caddy serves it there, behind that sign-in, and otherwise only an SSH tunnel reaches it: ssh -L 3000:localhost:3000 is not needed, task grafana opens one. Each app gets a dashboard (/d/app-&lt;name>) and alerts: a job that failed, was given up, keeps retrying or, on a schedule, is late; an integration that fails its check; 5xx answers, slow answers, restarts, and a database not backed up. They go to the owner by email and, with alerts_telegram_token and alerts_telegram_chat_id in the secrets, on Telegram.

```esquadro
blueprint observability
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [server](../server/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [caddy](../caddy/), [apps](../apps/) when the app uses them.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grafana_domain` | string | `""` | The domain Grafana answers on through Caddy, e.g. grafana.acme.com; without one, task grafana reaches it through SSH. |
| `retention_days` | int | `14` | Days the traces, metrics and logs are kept. |
| `alerts_language` | string | `"en"` | The language of the apps' alerts: en or pt-BR. |
| `alerts_http_error_ratio` | number | `0.05` | Alert when more than this share of an app's answers are 5xx, over 10 minutes with 20 requests or more. |
| `alerts_http_p95_seconds` | number | `2` | Alert when 95% of an app's answers take longer than this, in seconds, for 15 minutes. |
| `alerts_restarts` | int | `3` | Alert when each process of an app started more than this many times in 30 minutes. |
| `alerts_backup_hours` | int | `26` | Alert when an app's database has not been backed up for this many hours. |

```esquadro
blueprint observability {
  grafana_domain ""
}
```
